findings.contract: spec.md:452 and P5-T2 per-client verification counts
findings.problem: The per-axis row omits authored passed, failed, blocked and not-run verification counters. Reading the enum only to compute verified/conflicting loses required status information.
findings.reproduction: Four otherwise identical online outcomes with verification passed, failed, blocked and not-run all produce the exact same axis row: applicable=1, verified=0, required_pending=1.
findings.required_change: Expose per-client online/offline/mobile authored verification-state counts, including passed, failed, blocked and not-run, separately from evidence-backed verified/required_verified. Retain not-applicable applicability and disposition counts. Do not promote authored passed to verified, select one of conflicting representations, or count a feature/client/axis more than once.
findings.regression: Assert each required authored state separately, passed-with-invalid-proof remains unverified, consistent duplicate representations count once, conflicts remain explicit, optional undeclared axes remain not-required, and unavailable scope retains null metrics.

findings.contract: Execution environment/resource contract and ParityProjection prospective aggregate work invariant
findings.problem: For every axis, name in requirements.modes scans a tuple. The work reservation counts modes and names only once, so custom-mode membership is quadratic without accounting.
findings.required_change: Index required modes once after a prospective reservation and reuse constant-time membership, or reserve the actual aggregate comparisons before any scan. Preserve the independent output budget and fail without a partial result.
findings.regression: Use deterministic counted controls for increasing custom-mode populations and a one-unit-short work budget. Do not use elapsed-time thresholds or change accepted predecessor implementations.
